_source: LOG.md (career journal), career save persistent.sfs, flight recorder. Game: KSP 1.12.5 career 'kspbot', Normal difficulty, all flying by Claude through kRPC + own KspBot mod, no autopilot mods. One real day: 2026-09-24.

career_now.funds_spent_on_facilities: MC2 75k, TS2 + Pad2, VAB2 225k, AC2, R&D2 451k

firsts: First crewed Minmus landing and return (Minmus Lander 1, Bill)
First crewed Mun landing and return (Mun Lander 3, Bob)
Two Minmus observational survey contracts (8 sites)
Minmus biome tour: Midlands, Greater Flats, Lesser Flats, Highlands (+ Great Flats, Lowlands earlier)
Every Minmus surface biome visited (Poles, Flats, Slopes on Mun Lander 7)
First rendezvous + Klaw grab: an uncrewed tanker refuelled Bob's stranded Mun lander in Mun orbit (Mun Tanker 1)
First relay satellite: Polar Relay 1 (RA-2) in a 1259 x 1883 km polar orbit, launch timed for the contract's LAN

polar orbit; landed at Poles, Flats and Slopes, so every Minmus surface biome is now visited; orbital EVA report; science 5.5 -> 247; Jeb safe

orbit science + orbital EVA report; landed in Lowlands, hopped to Farside Crater; the old liftoff made the hop cost 1434 m/s, leaving 891 m/s, short of the ~970 needed to fly home. Stranded, then rescued: lifted to a 35 km Mun orbit, refuelled by Mun Tanker 1 (#24), tanks rebalanced after an uneven fill spun the lander, flew home and splashed down; Bob safe; science 274

career_launches.goal: refuel Bob's stranded lander in Mun orbit
career_launches.note: uncrewed OKTO + Klaw + 2x FL-T400 + Terrier; first launch reverted (circularization tooling bug); relaunch to a retrograde 30 km Mun orbit; first career rendezvous (plane 18 m/s, intercept 9 + 25 m/s, held 28 m), Klaw grab, 292 LF / 358 Ox transferred, released; hulk left in Mun orbit

career_launches.goal: Minmus observational survey (4 low sites) + science tour with barometer, Science Jr and a storage unit
career_launches.note: survey sites capped at 5.1-7.1 km: periapsis dips aimed over each site (decompiled trigger range 7.75 km); landed Lowlands, Greater Flats, Midlands, Great Flats; one liftoff escaped Minmus (liftoff bug), quickloaded; all data collected into the storage unit and recovered: science 105 -> 670, funds 1.31M

career_launches.goal: uncrewed Klaw rescue of Beafrod from Kerbin orbit
career_launches.note: first launch seated Jeb by default (recovered; --crew none); the accepted contracts were lost because kRPC launched without saving, so Beafrod's cabin was empty; rendezvous 1.7 m/s intercept, stopped 8.6 m off, the 12 m stack swung at 4-16 deg/s during the grab and hit the cabin (no damage); released; first engine-first uncrewed reentry with the service module kept until 300 m, pod recovered

career_launches.goal: contract polar orbit (inc 90, LAN 205, 1259 x 1883 km) with RA-2 relay + Science Jr
career_launches.note: launch timed on the pad's inertial longitude (LAN 204.1 on arrival); first match-orbit: plane 198 + 489 + 573 m/s, periapsis came out 13 % low and the plane burn dipped it into the air; fixed with a 30 m/s periapsis burn; contract done, first relay satellite

career_launches.goal: Klaw-grab the contract's loose Thud (Module 761V7) in Minmus orbit and bring it home
career_launches.note: crewed (CommNet signal required); arrival flipped from retrograde to prograde with correct --inc-to (7.7 m/s); rendezvous held 28 m; hours of engine-only grab attempts bounced off, the Thud spun up to 160 deg/s (stopped with a moment of rails warp); raycast face maps; Jeb home, science 62.7 -> 95.2 -> RCS researched

a 90 deg plane change tuned itself onto a Minmus escape (cost ignored the orbit's energy) and a recovery burn went the wrong way (orbital_speed_at is wrong on a hyperbola); recaptured by a closed-loop retrograde burn; RCS held the Klaw square to the Thud's flat face within 0.03-0.09 m at 0.15 m/s, yet every contact bounced (0.5 m/s back) until the monopropellant ran out; Klaw diagnostics (KspBot GrappleDebug) show it armed and Ready; Jeb home

bugs_found_and_fixed_fun: ascent autopilot flew nose-down at full thrust (Orbiter 1)
SRB stack 0.4° off axis = 26 kN·m torque vs a 5 kN·m wheel
autostrut on side boosters → explosion at t=0
kRPC biome lookup wants radians, not degrees → every biome-targeted landing looked at the wrong spot
Communotron antenna never unfolded → science 'transmitted' silently failed
survey waypoints accepted mid-flight don't count until a scene reload
kRPC launches straight into flight without saving: contracts accepted at the space center came back as 'offered', the rescue kerbal vanished, the advances stayed
